svg.title: zquota
svg.desc: Quota monitoring. Shows Z.ai quota use and exactly when each window resets, with exit codes cron can act on. Built in: Python, standard library only. Ships as: Homebrew tap, signed APT repository and pip. Install: brew tap netspeedy/zquota, then brew install zquota.
svg.text: Shows Z.ai quota use and exactly when each window resets, with
exit codes cron can act on.
Homebrew tap, signed APT repository and pip
